set.body: On an isolated worktree from current origin/main, forward-port Canvas resource disposal and forced WebGL context loss from commit 6b354f0, then add a surface-view-three-owned typed runtime option around validated Rgba32 clear colour with white compatibility default. Keep lifecycle and theming commits separable so theming can be applied to the current Neuropublish compatibility pin. Acceptance: Canvas JS disposal tests, Three JS idempotent context-loss tests, default and requested clear-colour tests, surfaceViewConformance, warning-clean compile, exact consumer handoff.
set.title: Forward-port Neuropublish viewer lifecycle and clear colour prerequisites
